requirements_summary: Workload: customer runs product analytics + support agent. Needs embeddings for search (large index), reranking for query intent, and chat for contextual help. Latency SLOs: chat p95 <= 120ms preferred (will accept 150ms if stable), embedding p95 <= 80ms. Throughput target: sustained 150-300 requests/second across features; peak burst up to 2x for event-driven product launches. Cost sensitivity: must reduce per-unit cost vs hosted by ~30-40% to justify Dedicated. Routing/fallback: primary in-vpc dedicated pool, automatic fallback to Redwood hosted API with strict throttling rules. Data residency: US-only; retention controls required. Model preferences: Llama2-13B quantized as baseline; upgrade path to 30B for critical rerank flows.
pricing_negotiation_notes: Customer initial ask: 12-month term, start with $10k/mo commit for months 1-3 (ramp) rising to $30k/mo by month 6; require ability to burst to 2x baseline with predictable billing cap.

Redwood counter (AE/SE proposal v3): baseline committed spend $25,000/mo (12mo) -> covers dedicated pool sized for steady-state. Includes 25% 'soft burst' allowance above baseline at no additional per-token charge; additional burst billed at 1.2x on-demand rate.

Overage mechanics: if monthly usage > committed + soft-burst allowance, overage billed at 120% of list on-demand unit rates; billing cap negotiable (proposed cap = 150% of committed invoice for first 3 months).

Ramp schedule proposal: months 1-3 bill at 50% of committed, months 4-6 at 75%, month 7 onward full committed rate. Customer asked for faster ramp (month 4 -> full) — procurement pushing back, want 3-month ramp max.

Burst reservation option: add-on reserve pools for planned launches (one-off pre-booked bursts) priced as flat fee per launch (example: $7k for a 72-hour 2x reserved burst). SummitGrove is very interested in reserved bursts for quarterly product pushes.

Discounting / credits: Redwood offered 10% credit on committed invoice if SLA p95 latency target missed in a month (credit formula defined in SLR appendix). Customer counter: wants stricter SLA with financial credit and objective measurement hooks (tracing + telemetry access).
Negotiation open items: exact unit rates for embeddings vs chat overage, final burst language for MSA, KMS/HSM attestation timeline, and an audit window for data residency proof.
